summary: UBS Group AG filed a Form 6-K containing transcripts of its Q2 2026 earnings call remarks and analyst Q&A. The CEO discussed progress on the Credit Suisse integration, record invested assets, and strong returns but announced no special-situation transaction. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. earnings press release, with no M&A, capital return, or activist event. It does not warrant special-situations categorization. What to watch: continued integration milestones and capital returns.
